description: This file defines the EmployeeTerminationAPI class, a RESTful API endpoint handling CRUD operations for employee termination records within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting termination records, along with validation rules and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing employee termination records, including methods for retrieval, creation, update, and deletion, with validation rules and OpenAPI annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee termination record based on employee number and record ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee termination record and associates it with the specified employee.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee termination record identified by employee number and record ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an employee termination record associated with an employee.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts employee number and termination record ID from request URL parameters.

methods.name: setEmployeeTerminationRecord
methods.description: Populates an EmployeeTerminationRecord entity with data from request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for retrieving a single termination record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to define validation rules for listing records.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for creating a new termination record.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Shared validation rules used by create and update methods for request body parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for updating an existing record, extending creation rules with record ID validation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for deleting a termination record by employee number.
